text:
For a **portable setup to keep essentials going**, I’d choose the **BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W solar-panel kit**. The listing gives it a **2,073.6 Wh battery** and says it can run a fridge and CPAP through a day and night; it lists the kit at **$1,199**. [See the kit and current listing](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit).

One caveat: **200 W of solar is modest**, and the panel may produce little during heavy cloud or rain. Charge the battery fully before a storm, and don’t count on solar to keep up with a fridge during bad weather. For a smaller budget, the same listing offers the **BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W kit for $729**, though I’d favor the larger battery for a multi-day outage. [Compare the options](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-hurricane-season).

If you’re trying to run **central AC, a well pump, or multiple major appliances**, this portable kit may not be enough; you’d need a larger home-backup system.
